name: Chocolate Cake
instruction: Imagine a chocolate cake that looks absolutely delectable. The cake should be round with multiple layers. Each layer is separated by a rich chocolate filling. The top of the cake is covered in a smooth chocolate glaze, with a few decorative swirls. Add some chocolate shavings on top for extra appeal. The cake should be placed on a simple cake stand.

Shape accuracy: The object in the images is a round chocolate cake.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The layers are of equal thickness.
The decorative swirls are proportionate to the top surface.
Texture and surface detail: The cake has a soft, moist texture.
The chocolate glaze appears smooth and glossy.
The chocolate shavings add a textured detail on top.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The layers are stacked vertically and aligned.
The cake stand supports the cake adequately.
The decorative swirls are placed evenly on the top.
Object distance and contact: The cake is centered on the cake stand.
There is no gap between the cake and the stand.
The layers are tightly packed with no visible gaps.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified attributes of the cake are accurately represented.
The cake has multiple layers with chocolate filling as instructed.
The top is covered with chocolate glaze and decorated with swirls and shavings.
